name: dynamic-workflows
description: Run bounded delegate fan-outs and durable workflow scripts that orchestrate sub-agents in code.

config.description: Run several independent delegate tasks concurrently and return their results.

Run a durable workflow script: JavaScript that orchestrates sub-agents. Helpers: agent(prompt, {label, preset, max_tokens, timeout_secs, schema, json}) resolves to the agent's text (or parsed JSON with schema/json); parallel([() => agent(...), ...]) runs thunks concurrently (a failed one yields null); pipeline(items, ...stages) streams each item through async stages; phase(title) labels progress; log(...) records notes; args holds the 'args' input. The body is an async function body: use await and return the result. Sub-agents run as the calling agent. Every finished agent() call is checkpointed: if Ryu restarts, a background task crashes, or a provider rate/usage/session limit is hit, the run resumes on its own and finished agents are not run again. The call waits up to wait_secs for the result; if the run is still going, call again with run_id to keep waiting. Calling again with the same script and args re-attaches to the same run instead of starting over.

script.description: Async JavaScript body using agent(), parallel(), pipeline(), phase(), log(), and args.

args.description: Any JSON value passed to the script as args.

preset.description: Default sub-agent preset (research when omitted). code_write runs the calling agent with its tools.

run_key.description: Set to run the same script and args again as a separate run.

run_id.description: Follow an existing run instead of starting one.

wait_secs.description: How long to wait for the result (default 300).
